description: Establishment of Advisory Committees to strengthen and promote local industries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- With the aim of minimizing policy issues in industrial and entrepreneurship development, 20 Advisory Committees have been established by now covering the manufacturing industry sectors. It has been identified that more Advisory Committees covering 07 specific industry sectors need to be established. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development to establish Advisory Committees for the following industry sectors, consisting of not more than 25 members representing Government institutions, Chambers of Commerce/Conventions, academic institutions (universities and research institutes) and experts in the relevant industry sector, was approved by the Cabinet:

Local Ayurveda and Traditional Medicine Sectors
Confectionery - related Manufacturing Industries Sector
Traditional Handicrafts Sector
Poultry-related Industry Sector
Ornamental Fish and Seaweed-related Industry Sector
Creative Arts-related Industry Sector
Event Management Sector
